page.notes: The first entry's leading word is partly damaged: read as "lam" with a doubtful first letter, probably "Iam". Entry 11 page number is printed with a spaced, worn "2" and read as 72; entry 14 page number is read as 105. The final entry is cut off at the right edge of the scan, so it stays a fragment.
